verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile lets you snapshot/replay Homebrew's own installed state and is likened to package.json/Gemfile, but there's no documented tool for importing/converting an existing project's dependency manifest from another package manager (e.g., apt, MacPorts, Nix) into Homebrew. Community evidence only shows anecdotal switching to/from Homebrew, not an official conversion tool.
